task:
Humanize all GTA Labs marketing content across content/offers/*.mdx, content/blog/*.mdx, and content/case-notes/*.mdx in the ~/pro/web/apps/gta-labs repo. Apply the humanizer skill to every file. Skip content/offers/data-ready.mdx (already humanized in sprint-20260406-142948-c9215f).

Goal: remove AI writing tells and inject real voice without changing meaning, facts, prices, deliverables, or frontmatter fields.

Acceptance criteria per file:
- 0 em dashes in prose (— and – both banned; hyphens in number ranges like 20-500 are fine)
- 0 rule-of-three triplets (watch for '\''X, Y, and Z'\'' parallel lists)
- 0 promotional vocabulary: leverage, utilize, streamline, robust, seamless, testament, pivotal, vibrant, tapestry, landscape (abstract), underscore, delve, intricate, showcase, boasts, nestled, in the heart of, must-visit, breathtaking, stunning, groundbreaking, renowned
- 0 negative parallelisms ('\''not just X, it'\''s Y'\'', '\''not only...but also'\'')
- 0 'Furthermore', 'Moreover', 'Additionally' at sentence starts
- No 'I'\''d be happy to', 'Great question', 'it'\''s worth noting'
- Preserve all frontmatter fields (title, slug, summary, price, order, icon) exactly as-is
- Preserve all prices, timelines, deliverable bullets, and concrete specifics
- Preserve all internal links and MDX components
- Keep brand voice: direct, punchy, slightly impatient with consulting theatre (match ~/clawd/SOUL.md writing rules)
- Vary sentence rhythm — mix short punchy lines with longer ones
- Use 'is/are/has' instead of 'serves as/stands as/boasts'

Dev agent: Connie (content specialist) with humanizer skill. Process files one at a time. For each file, read it, identify AI tells, rewrite in place, move on. Do not commit.

QA agent: Quinn. For each file, grep-check em dash count, scan for banned vocabulary, verify no triplets, confirm frontmatter is untouched. Report defects with line numbers. Spot-check 3 files by reading full before/after to verify voice quality (not just mechanical compliance).

Out of scope: src/, package.json, mah.yaml changes, design system files, any non-MDX files. Do not touch content/pages (those are landing page fragments, will be handled separately).
